data.one_liner: Flutter utilities for adaptive UI breakpoints, color parsing, typed lists, and context extensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides helpful extensions and helper methods for Flutter development including breakpoint layout detection, robust color parsing and accessibility utilities, typed list and sliver list widgets, and focused BuildContext extensions.
use_when: You need adaptive layouts and breakpoint utilities across platforms.
You want advanced color parsing, contrast checks, and WCAG compliance tools.
You want concise typed list widgets and context helper extensions.
avoid_when: You rely strictly on standard SDK Material types without adopting the material_ui package ecosystem.
You require complex state management solutions (use a dedicated state library instead).
strengths: Comprehensive color toolkit supporting hex, rgb, hsl, hwb, and contrast checks.
Handy typed list and sliver list builders.
Adaptive breakpoint management for responsive UI development.
weaknesses: Requires manual migration steps and dependency alignment for Material-specific helpers.
Extracts core notifiers out to other packages, requiring separate dependencies for legacy workflows.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_helper_utils to pubspec.yaml and optionally depend on material_ui if using Material-specific components.
